title: The Philosophy of Mystery
author: Walter Cooper Dendy

authorInfo.bio: Walter Cooper Dendy (1794–1871) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Philosophy of Mystery" by Walter Cooper Dendy is a philosophical treatise examining the nature and implications of the supernatural, particularly focusing on ghosts, spirits, and their representations throughout history. Written in the early 19th century, it combines elements of philosophy, psychology, and anecdotal narrative to explore belief in the supernatural and the motivations behind such beliefs.
